Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS (ATC) Procurement of RCC Pipes for Connecting Campus Drainage Network with STP and Pon ds Purchaser: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT), Bengaluru Campus 1. Scope of Work / Supply The purchaser invites quotations for the supply of the following material for connecting the existin g campus drainage network with the Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) and ponds. S. No. Description of Item Quantity 1 RCC Pipe, 600 mm diameter, NP3 class, 2.5-meter length per pipe 55 Nos. Total Required Quantity: 55 Nos.

2. Background and Requirement The campus drainage network is required to be connected with the STP and designated ponds to f acilitate the proper flow and management of treated water and stormwater, as applicable. As assessed by the Estate/Engineering Section, 55 Nos. of RCC pipes of 600 mm diameter, N P3 class, and 2.5-meter length each are required for completing the drainage connectivity wo rk. Non-availability of the required pipes may delay completion of the drainage network and result in waterlogging, overflow or underutilisation of the STP output. Therefore, procurement of the materi als is considered essential for timely completion of the work. 3. Technical Specifications The supplied RCC pipes shall meet the following minimum requirements: 1. Material: Reinforced Cement Concrete (RCC). 2. Nominal Diameter: 600 mm. 3. Pipe Class: NP3. 4. Length: 2.5 meters per pipe. 5. Quantity: 55 Nos. 6. Quality: Pipes shall conform to the applicable BIS standards for RCC pipes, including IS 458, as applicable to the specified class and dimensions. 7. Pipes shall be free from cracks, honeycombing, visible defects and manufacturing damage. 8. The supplier shall provide relevant quality/test certificates, wherever applicable. 4. Delivery Requirements 1. The complete quantity of 55 RCC pipes shall be delivered at RGIPT Bengaluru Campus. 2. Delivery shall be completed within 20 days from the date of issue of the Purchase Ord er, or within the delivery period specified in the GeM contract. 3. The supplier shall ensure safe transportation, unloading and placement of pipes at the desig nated campus location. 4. Any damaged or defective material identified during inspection shall be replaced by the sup plier at no additional cost. 5. Inspection and Acceptance 1. All supplied materials shall be inspected by the authorised representative of RGIPT Bengalur u Campus. 2. Acceptance shall be subject to verification of quantity, dimensions, NP3 classification, qualit y and conformity with the prescribed specifications. 3. RGIPT reserves the right to reject defective or non-conforming materials. 4. Payment shall be processed only after satisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance of th e materials. 6. Financial Details S. N Particulars Quantit Unit Rate ( Amount ( o. y ₹) ₹) 1 RCC Pipe, 600 mm diameter, NP3 class, 2.5-mete 55 Nos. As per RA As per RA r length Total including GST, as per estimate As per RA The quoted price shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, transportation, loading, unloading and o ther incidental charges up to the delivery location at RGIPT Bengaluru Campus. 7. Payment Terms Payment shall be released through the prescribed institutional procedure after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance of the complete quantity, submission of the invoice and fulfilment of ap plicable contractual requirements.

8. Warranty and Replacement The supplier shall be responsible for replacing any material found defective or damaged due to ma nufacturing defects or improper transportation, at no additional cost to RGIPT. 9. General Conditions 1. The supplier shall comply with all applicable statutory and safety requirements during trans portation and delivery. 2. The purchaser reserves the right to verify the credentials and technical compliance of the su pplier. 3. Any deviation from the prescribed technical specifications may result in rejection of the sup plied material. 4. All other terms and conditions of the GeM bid/contract shall remain applicable. 5. In case of any conflict, the GeM General Terms and Conditions and applicable procurement r ules shall prevail. Purchaser: Rajiv Gandhi Institute of Petroleum Technology (RGIPT) Bengaluru Campus .
